_meta.purpose: External Support Index (ESI) manual coding for MI research-integrity robustness test; higher = more external support
sources: IMF program history (MONA/arrangement records, coded from documented program arcs)
NATO accession records + US treaty/Major-Non-NATO-Ally designations + CSTO
Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute-type AUM figures + World Bank GDP
_meta.coding_notes: Conservative defaults (0/none/null) where uncertain. imf_program_active counts any active SBA/EFF/SAF/ESAF/PRGF/ECF/PRGT or precautionary/FCL arrangement; pure emergency instruments (RFI/RCF/EPCA) coded 0. imf_cumulative_years_20yr are best-effort estimates from program arcs (mostly low confidence; null where not estimable). NATO 1.0 includes full members and mutual-defense treaties with a nuclear power (US treaties for JPN/KOR; CSTO Art.4 with Russia for ARM/KAZ, noted); ISR coded 1.0 de-facto (no formal treaty, noted). SWF figures are approximate AUM/GDP ratios, low confidence.
